releases.name: v0.2.0 — First release: bilingual CLI, English-first docs
releases.notes:
**pixellogo 0.2.0** is the first tagged release: a command line tool that turns a title, a few subtitle lines and a footnote into real 8-bit / retro-terminal pixel art — PNG and SVG from the same geometry, five canvases, ten palettes, and mixed Latin / Chinese / Japanese / Korean text without missing glyphs.

## Highlights

- **Real pixels, not a filter.** Text is rasterized into a binary mask and merged per row into integer-coordinate rectangles. Every edge stays a whole block at any zoom: no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no feathering.
- **One geometry, two formats.** PNG and SVG are produced from the same `Scene`, so they match pixel for pixel. The SVG is self-contained and needs no font files.
- **Five canvases.** `poster` 1080×1440, `card` 1440×1080, `banner` 1280×640, `slide` 1920×1080, `square` 1080×1080, each with its own layout strategy.
- **Ten palettes.** From retro terminal to paper journal; every preset passes a WCAG contrast check (`--list presets` prints the ratio).
- **CJK-ready.** A Chinese pixel font ships in the box, so mixed Latin/Chinese lines keep one stroke weight; Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean download on demand.
- **Bilingual CLI.** Help page, option tables, font status, warnings and errors in English or Simplified Chinese — automatic from the terminal locale, or forced with `--ui-lang`.
- **No browser dependency.** Pure Python and Pillow ras…

releases.name: 3.0.1 — enforced candidate menu, per-source chains, comparing gate
releases.notes:
## What changed

3.0.1 closes the gap between what the README promised and what the code enforced. The short version: a Go model id can no longer be invented, chain length follows the source, Markdown agents can actually be written, the mode question is asked once, and `check` re-derives the numbers instead of trusting the file.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301---2026-11-03) for the full list. The Chinese changelog is at [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md).

## Install this release

Download **`opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip`** below. It is the minimal package, not the GitHub "source code" archive:

- top-level directory is `opencode-go-model-picker/`
- it contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/` and `LICENSE` — no tests, no docs site, no `assets/`, no `.git`, no `node_modules`
- 18 files

Extract it into your OpenCode skills directory so the folder name matches the skill name:

```bash
unzip opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -d ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```powershell
Expand-Archive opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -DestinationPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\skills"
```

Then ask OpenCode to check your agent models. The skill is read-only until you confirm a diff.

en.headline: 64 own commits plus 18 automated across five repositories
en.summary: **64 own commits** were made across five repositories, plus 18 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, work covered bilingual CLI output, on-demand multilingual glyph variants, Korean font handling, right-side decoration spacing, and expanded README examples, followed by the `v0.2.0` release with English-first docs and PNG/SVG output from shared geometry. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, the `starlight-docs` skill gained templates, a detect/scaffold/check/audit/emit-check script skeleton, and documentation, while mobile splash controls and external-link false positives were fixed. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, the `plain-language` skill was installed, the role roster was updated to 11 bundled skills, routing and Mermaid guidance were revised, and knowledge notes recorded a 40%→0.x% user test result. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, candidate menus, per-source chains, and a fail-closed comparing gate were enforced, and `v3.0.1` was released. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, daily, summary, and index pages were re-rendered, and PR/Issue labels and issue wording were corrected to use action counts. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or discussions were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: The first tagged release provides a bilingual CLI that renders titles, subtitles, and footnotes as 8-bit pixel art in PNG and SVG from the same geometry. It includes five canvases, ten palettes, and mixed Latin, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text without missing glyphs.

This release enforces the candidate menu, per-source chain lengths, and a comparing check gate that re-derives values instead of trusting the file. It also allows Markdown agents to be written and asks the mode question once.

zh.headline: 64 次本人提交，另有 18 次自动提交，覆盖五个仓库
zh.summary: 当天在五个仓库完成 **64 次本人提交**，另有 18 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 完善了中英双语命令行、按需下载的多语言字形变体、韩语字体处理与右侧装饰间距，并扩充 README 示例，随后发布 `v0.2.0`，以同一套几何数据输出 PNG 与 SVG。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 新增 `starlight-docs` 模板资源与 detect/scaffold/check/audit/emit-check 脚本骨架及文档，同时修复手机端启动页控件和外链检查误报。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 安装 `plain-language` 技能，将随包技能数量更新为实测的 11 个，修订角色路由与 Mermaid 规范，并记录用户实测的 40%→0.x% 结果。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 落实候选菜单、按来源链长与失败即拦截的比较门禁，并发布 `v3.0.1`。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 重新渲染 daily、summary 与 index 页面，并将 PR/Issue 标签及 issue 表述改为动作数口径。当天没有记录 pull request、issue、review 或讨论。

releaseNotes.summary: 首个带标签版本提供双语命令行，可将标题、副标题与脚注渲染为 8-bit 像素画，并以同一套几何数据生成 PNG 和 SVG。它包含五种画布、十套调色板，以及不缺失字形的拉丁文、中文、日文和韩文混排支持。
该版本落实候选菜单、按来源确定的链长，以及重新计算数值而非信任文件的比较门禁。它还允许编写 Markdown agent，并将模式问题改为只询问一次。
